import psycopg2

def search_employee(name_query):
    """Search for employees by name in the internal directory."""
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        host="internal-db.corp.local",
        database="employees",
        user="app_user",
        password="corp_readonly_pass"
    )
    
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Build and execute the query
    query = f"SELECT id, name, email, department, salary FROM employees WHERE name ILIKE '%{name_query}%'"
    cursor.execute(query)
    
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return results

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        name = sys.argv[1]
        employees = search_employee(name)
        for emp in employees:
            print(f"{emp[1]} ({emp[2]}) - {emp[3]}")
    else:
        print("Usage: python search.py <name>")
